profile.headline: Actively looking for a job change. Currently working as a Senior Full stack java developer at Goldman Sachs

positions.title: Sr. Java Full stack developer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description: Goldman Sachs(GS) is a global structure allows us to better serve the strategic and financing needs of our clients across all geographies and industries. IBD encompasses two areas: IBD Classic and our Financing group. This dual structure enables us to offer the broadest range of products and advisory services, furthering our ability to deliver best-in-class solutions to our clients.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
United Parcel Service (UPS) is an American multinational package delivery and supply chain management company.
As a part of UPS Airlines the fleet crew data is managed through crew applications. Crew applications run on legacy systems and there is a need to migrate them to newer technologies. I am a part of this effort in integrating vendor(s) and UPS built products with Crew Legacy Applications. The current UPS build product that I am working on is Crew replacement and line gen which mainly deals with transporting flight data from Net line production server to a vendor product utilizing camel routes and Rest Services using Spring Boot.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description: Loan Management System helps to better support clients and manage book of business. It provides organized loan information and access to transaction history, loan status, loan maintenance screens, etc., Loans can be grouped to form pools based on numerous search criteria. This system also provides access to many reports including daily, monthly & quarterly reports and interfaces with the check generation engines via web services.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: This project is an insurance marketing application for Insurance agents. This is a web based application consisting of three main modules: ‘Query’, ‘Policy’ and ‘Rate Quote’. The ‘Query’ module is the interface with the insurance agent to query the data base and generate customizable reports. The ‘Policy’ module concerns the various insurance sectors Health and Life insurance. The ‘Rate Quote’ module provides rates and payment terms, funding and protection options and coverage details for the insurance policy.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description: Genentech is a leading biotechnology company that discovers, develops, manufactures and commercializes medicines to treat patients with serious or life-threatening medical conditions. We are among the world's leading biotech companies, with multiple products on the market and a promising development pipelineGenentech Research and Early Development operates as an independent center within Roche.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
1. IMAG500 (Identity Managed Access Gateway) provides complete Identity life cycle management for all the Identities that exist at the applications and networks in the enterprise. IMAG500 uniquely cleanses and reconciles the identities and enforces them on the networks on a per-packet basis to provide granular access to resources both at application and network.IMAG500’s Identity based access control bridges the two domains of application security and network security. Any update to Identities result in automatic updates of access policies in IMAG500 and in turn secures the resources.

2. This Project is designed to enhance the efficiency of the customer acquisition process. The product mainly manages all the Leads that originate from all sources like Internet, SMS, and Telephonic etc. Administrator can create Product, Campaign and an organization for a product and he also configures users for an organization. Automates from the origin of the Lead to allocation of Leads to Telesales.
